body:
Pair-asymmetric preprocess, segmented SVT-AV1 encode, and PASC sidecar tune for competitive classical compression.

# submission name:
pair_sidecar

# upload zipped `archive.zip`
[archive.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29579215/archive.zip)


# report.txt
```
=== Evaluation config ===
  batch_size: 16
  device: cpu
  num_threads: 2
  prefetch_queue_depth: 4
  report: submissions/pair_sidecar/report.txt
  seed: 1234
  submission_dir: submissions/pair_sidecar
  uncompressed_dir: /Users/williamayoade/Desktop/comma_video_compression_challenge/videos
  video_names_file: /Users/williamayoade/Desktop/comma_video_compression_challenge/public_test_video_names.txt
=== Evaluation results over 600 samples ===
  Average PoseNet Distortion: 0.00085139
  Average SegNet Distortion: 0.00582351
  Submission file size: 823,752 bytes
  Original uncompressed size: 37,545,489 bytes
  Compression Rate: 0.02194011
  Final score: 100*segnet_dist + √(10*posenet_dist) + 25*rate = 1.22
```

# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?
no

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?
yes

# is this submission competitive or innovative? explain why
 competitive. While we do not beat the #1 submission, we are better than the best classical AV1+sidecar baseline on the leaderboard(~1.24), with a score of 1.22.  


# additional comments
Submission is AV1 video + a sidecar of per-frame corrections. Evaluation is CPU-only and finishes under 30-minutes.
